newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Clinton to visit Netherlands May 28-29.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to visit Netherlands May 28-29.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will make an official visit to the Netherlands on May 28 and 29, a spokesman for the Dutch Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.

The ministry said earlier this month Clinton would visit the Netherlands this year as part of a traditional round of meetings between the U.S. president and the European Union presidency, which rotates every six months between the bloc's 15 members.
Clinton and Dutch and EU leaders will discuss a range of issues, including European security, the Middle East, Yugoslavia and Russia.
The visit coincides with ceremonies planned to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Marshall Aid Plan to regenerate Europe in the wake of World War Two.
